## Context
Club finance teams did not want to reconcile direct debit mandates, and instalments raise chargeback exposure.

## Decision
Card only for season tickets, using a saved provider token for auto-renewal.

## Consequences
Members who cannot pay the full amount at once have no option in the app; clubs handle hardship cases by phone.
